author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
How does Adam Savage organize his spare charging and connector cables, and what suggestions does he have for makers who live in apartments? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members edwinbear7065 and sentientai9266, whom we thank for their support!

NOTE: We tried YouTube's new "thumbnail creation" tool and we're putting it to an A/B test alongside our original thumb out of curiosity. Let's see which thumbnail wins!
